From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>

Subject: Request: one-off runway boost & POC extension for NorthStitch Labs

Hi team — looping you in on a time-sensitive ask from NorthStitch. Stacey (cc'd) is running a proof-of-concept with our modular embeddings + reranking flow; they're seeing promising signals but hit the PLG credit ceiling and need more runway to finish a critical integration that will determine their seed purchase decision.

Quick context:
- Trial started 2026-05-05; active engineering engagement since 05/12.
- Usage spiked during integration smoke tests; current PLG credits exhausted as of 06/05.
- Customer requests: 60-day extension + additional $15k of complimentary credits to cover higher-than-expected infra during model tuning.

Why this matters:
- NorthStitch is a pre-seed startup with strong product-market fit in a regulated vertical (prosthetics data ingestion). They already committed to a pilot integration with their engineering lead onsite next week.
- Sales signal: customer has budgeted for a paid deployment contingent on this final eval — their procurement lead confirmed a Q3 purchase intent in our discovery call.

Ask: I’m requesting one-off executive approval for a 60-day POC extension and up to $15k credits (hosted usage) outside standard PLG thresholds. If we can’t extend/runway, we risk losing them to an in-house solution.

Attachments: POC performance summary + a quick draft addendum for the extended window.

Proposed guardrails (preferred):
- 60-day extension starting 2026-06-09; credits unlocked in two tranches (8k now, 7k after 30 days subject to engagement check-in).
- Usage caps to avoid open-ended consumption (soft cap at 50M tokens / month).
- Customer signs a pilot addendum with commitment to a product evaluation checklist and a named procurement contact.

Stacey — appreciate any color you want us to include for the execs.

Thanks,
Sofia

Thanks — pricing/deal desk notes below.

Summary of requested concession: 60-day extension + $15k complimentary hosted credits. Standard PLG limits stop at $2k for automated trial unlocks; one-off approvals are possible but need exec escalation for any >$10k concession.

Proposed deal desk compromise (recommended):
- Approve 60-day extension.
- Initial credit tranche: $8,000 complimentary credits to be applied immediately.
- Contingent credit tranche: additional $6,000 unlocked after a 30-day product check-in showing active API calls and progress on the integration (total possible complimentary credits = $14,000).
- Require an addendum: pilot scope, target success metrics, named procurement contact, and a conversion check on day 45.

I’ve attached a proposed addendum draft and linked the HubSpot deal for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/9273/deal/9273

If legal signs off fast, finance can process this as a non-billable credit ledger entry and we’ll track against one-off concessions for Q2.

-Marissa

Rishi — quick summary and ask:
- Customer: NorthStitch Labs (prospect), HubSpot deal HUB-9273
- Ask: 60-day extension + up to $15k in complimentary hosted credits (Sofia requested $15k).
- Deal desk recommends $14k in two tranches (8k now / 6k conditional).
- Business case: high-intent integration with engineering-led eval; likely to convert to a paid hosted deployment (~$75k ARR annualized) within 2–3 months if the POC succeeds.

Given the conversion upside and the fact we can gate the second tranche on an objective check-in, I support the compromise and request your sign-off to proceed.

Let me know if you need additional risk controls — e.g., tighter token caps, monitoring hooks in Console, or an automatic shutdown if usage exceeds 120% of the soft cap.

Authorization summary:
- Approve 60-day extension effective 2026-06-09.
- Complimentary credits: $8,000 to be applied immediately; up to $6,000 contingent on a successful 30-day integration checkpoint (total possible credits = $14,000). We will not approve the full $15k request as an open concession.
- Controls: soft token cap 50M tokens / month; automatic alert to Deal Desk at 85% consumption; immediate suspension of further complimentary credit releases if checkpoint criteria are not met.
- Legal: sign pilot addendum (Marissa to coordinate) with explicit conversion review on day 45.

Marissa — please issue the credits and add the concession to our one-off concessions ledger. Finance, please track as non-billable credits against Q2 concession budget.
